title: Browse a bay’s compatible module types
steps: Inspect the loaded Module Types catalog, including the two SFP-25G-SR-C rows and their manufacturers.
Follow Module Bay Types in the Devices navigation, open SFP28 transceiver bay, and inspect the Compatible Module Types list.
Scroll down to the end of the compatible list and the Tags, Comments, and Module Bays cards.
Scroll back up to the bay heading and the first compatible module types.

video_guide.summary: Compare the manufacturer-labeled catalog with the bay’s model-only compatible list and inspect the sections below it.

chapters.note: The catalog lists SFP-25G-SR-C twice, associated with Cisco and Generic in the Manufacturer column.

chapters.label: Follow Module Bay Types in the Devices navigation.

chapters.note: Compatible Module Types appears inside the attributes card as model-only links. Two SFP-25G-SR-C links are separated by SFP-25G-ZR, with no manufacturer labels beside them.

chapters.label: Scroll to the end of the compatible list.

chapters.note: The final model links appear above Tags, Comments, and Module Bays.

chapters.label: Scroll back to the bay heading and beginning of the compatible list.

chapters.note: The bay heading and first model-only compatible links are visible; the displayed collection has no manufacturer column or sorting headings.
